cases.scope: Two abstract winning resize requests, fixed retained populations 2..4, all requester pairs and three abstract root outcomes per request (success and two distinguishable errors). P0 is the sole authoritative result producer. Local-result control source-characterizes P0-only setup failure with non-root local success; three other controls reject a proposed early shared read, stale epoch and record reuse before all replies. Positive is an unimplemented tagged publication plus reply acknowledgment contract under sequential consistency and eventual completion. Paper work-closure principles motivate acknowledgment but do not prescribe result storage or prove Gambit barriers. Excludes processor-count changes, requester retirement, simultaneous request selection, actual error encoding/origin, arbitrary epochs/cardinality, C memory ordering, quarantined VM teardown and native acceptance. No claim that join-error return is already implemented.
